outcome: depressive disorder risk (measured by EPDS cut-offs >= 9 and >= 12)
cohort: A cross-section of 2,561 eligible at-term women screened on the second day postpartum prior to discharge from a maternity ward in Italy.
finding: The study identified different obstetric and perinatal determinants associated with depressive symptom profiles, with younger maternal age, complementary feeding, and formula feeding being risk factors, and employment being protective, depending on the EPDS cut-off threshold (>= 9 or >= 12) used on the second day postpartum.
